# Querentia

> Querentia Inc. is a trusted recruitment partner, placing exceptional talent, both tech and non-tech, with leading organizations across North America and beyond since 2021. Tagline: Talent. Trust. Thrive.

Querentia is a recruitment and talent-solutions firm with offices across Canada and the United States. We connect employers with high-quality, high-impact candidates across 42 disciplines and 7 practice areas, for permanent and contract roles. Our promise: Talent. Trust. Thrive.

- Founded: 2021
- Locations: offices in Toronto and Vancouver (Canada) and New York City and Silicon Valley (USA); registered offices in Oakville, ON and Dover, DE
- Area served: Canada, the United States, and internationally
- Audiences: employers hiring talent, and candidates seeking roles
- Specialties: technology AND non-tech: engineering, data, cloud, cybersecurity, finance, HR, marketing, supply chain, project delivery, and more
- Track record: 500+ successful placements, 94% placement retention, 48-hour average shortlist
- Contact: info@querentia.com · 1-877-669-1214

- [Hot Jobs](https://querentia.com/hot-jobs): Featured, actively-shortlisting roles.
- [Contact](https://querentia.com/contact): Get in touch to hire talent or explore a role.

- Permanent hiring (full-time placements)
- Contract and contract-to-hire staffing
- Specialist and niche search across 30+ disciplines
